{"script":"set -e
ws=line_count_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"
src=/root/matrix.txt
if [ ! -r "$src" ]; then echo "ERROR: /root/matrix.txt not found or not readable" >&2; exit 2; fi
realpath_src=$(realpath "$src")
perm=$(stat -c '%A %a' "$src")
printf "path: %s\npermissions: %s\n" "$realpath_src" "$perm" > "$ws/source_info.txt"
cp --preserve=all "$src" "$ws/original_copy.txt"
sha256sum "$ws/original_copy.txt" > "$ws/checksums.txt"
cp "$ws/original_copy.txt" "$ws/working.txt"
stat -c "size: %s\nmtime: %y" "$ws/working.txt" > "$ws/working_info.txt"
charset=$(file -b --mime-encoding "$ws/working.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
echo "detected_charset: $charset" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"
norm_anomalies=""
if grep -q $'\r' "$ws/working.txt"; then
  sed -i 's/\r$//' "$ws/working.txt"
  echo "converted CRLF->LF" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"
fi
if [ "$charset" != "utf-8" ]; then
  if command -v iconv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if iconv -f "$charset" -t UTF-8 "$ws/working.txt" -o "$ws/working.txt".utf8 2>/dev/null; then
      mv "$ws/working.txt".utf8 "$ws/working.txt"
      echo "converted encoding $charset -> UTF-8" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"
    else
      echo "iconv failed to convert from $charset" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"
      norm_anomalies="iconv_failed"
    fi
  else
    echo "iconv not available; could not convert from $charset" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"
    norm_anomalies="iconv_missing"
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$norm_anomalies" ]; then echo "anomalies: $norm_anomalies" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"; fi
orig_lines=$(wc -l < "$ws/working.txt")
awk '{ a[NR]=$0 } END{ last=0; for(i=1;i<=NR;i++){ if(a[i] ~ /[^[:space:]]/) last=i } if(last==0){ exit 0 } for(i=1;i<=last;i++) print a[i] }' "$ws/working.txt" > "$ws/working.txt.tmp"
new_lines=$(wc -l < "$ws/working.txt.tmp" || true)
if [ -z "$new_lines" ]; then new_lines=0; fi
removed=$((orig_lines - new_lines))
mv "$ws/working.txt.tmp" "$ws/working.txt"
echo "removed_trailing_empty_lines: $removed" >> "$ws/working_info.txt"
{
 echo "=== first 20 lines ==="
 head -n 20 "$ws/working.txt"
 echo "=== last 20 lines ==="
 tail -n 20 "$ws/working.txt"
} > "$ws/preview.txt"
sha256sum "$ws/working.txt" >> "$ws/checksums.txt"
orig_sum=$(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' "$ws/checksums.txt")
work_sum=$(awk 'NR==2{print $1}' "$ws/checksums.txt")
if [ "$orig_sum" = "$work_sum" ]; then
  echo "verification: checksums match" >> "$ws/checksums.txt"
else
  echo "verification: checksums differ" >> "$ws/checksums.txt"
fi
echo "path: $(realpath "$ws/working.txt")" > "$ws/ready_to_count.txt"
if [ -z "$norm_anomalies" ]; then
 echo "verification: all verification steps passed" >> "$ws/ready_to_count.txt"
else
 echo "verification: anomalies detected -> $norm_anomalies" >> "$ws/ready_to_count.txt"
fi
echo "ready: file prepared for line counting" >> "$ws/ready_to_count.txt"
lines=$(wc -l < "$src")
echo "$lines""}
